bagPolicy.summary: Addition Financial Arena enforces a clear bag policy, prohibiting backpacks and bags larger than 12'' x 6'' x 12''. Small purses no larger than 5.5'' x 8.5'' are allowed.
allowed: Small purses approximately the size of a hand (no larger than 5.5'' x 8.5'')
bagPolicy.note: An exception will be made for medically necessary items after proper inspection at the front doors.

parking.note: Event parking is available in Garages F, D, H, and lots D1 and D2, with advanced purchase options on Ticketmaster or at the Venue Box Office. Parking is free for UCF students and staff with a valid UCF ID during University events.

rideshare.note: Drop off locations for patrons are located at the corners of East Plaza Drive and Gemini Blvd and West Plaza Drive and Gemini Blvd.

concessions.note: Addition Financial Arena offers a variety of food and drink options, including Cuban sandwiches, chicken tenders, and artisan pizzas. The venue is cashless, accepting major credit cards and Apple Pay. Special offerings include exclusive student discounts at Knightmare Snacks during UCF basketball games.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Accessible seating is available on the main concourse, with elevators on the west side of the arena lobby. Accessible parking is offered in Garages D and F. Call 407-823-3070 in advance for interpreting, wheelchair, or other accommodation requests.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Once a guest leaves during an event, re-entry is not permitted unless another ticket is purchased.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Will Call
ticketPickup.body: The box office is in front of the arena on East Plaza Drive. Will-call tickets may be collected only by the named account holder with valid government-issued ID. Regular hours are Monday–Friday, 10:00 a.m.–2:00 p.m.; event-day hours vary.

gates.title: Entrance & Doors
gates.body: Public doors generally open one hour before the scheduled event, although times may vary. Arrive early for security screening and use the entrance designated in event communications or on-site signage.
